page_title: LYO 3-3 LOR | Lyon v Lorient 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Clement Turpin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jake O'Brien (Lyon).
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) is brought on as a substitute for Aiyegun Tosin.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Johann Lepenant (Lyon) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.

90' Mama Balde (Lyon) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Yvon Mvogo shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
88' Substitution. Maxence Caqueret leaves the pitch and is replaced by Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
88' Half-chance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) plays a pass into the box, but Yvon Mvogo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
88' A corner kick by Lyon is thwarted by the well prepared Yvon Mvogo (Lorient).

87' Mama Balde (Lyon) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Good work from Lyon as they win a corner.
87' Substitution. Theo Le Bris did his best and is replaced by Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient).
84' Good defending. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) tries to find Alexandre Lacazette inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
84' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) is penalised for holding. Clement Turpin signals a set piece.
83' Mama Balde (Lyon) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball inside the right post, but his shot is deflected by one of the defending players away.
81' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) serves up a nice cross, but Yvon Mvogo punches the ball away.
79' 3 - 3 What a beauty from just outside the box! Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
78' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is penalised for a foul. Clement Turpin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
78' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
77' A substitution has been made. Eli Junior Kroupi is replaced by Bassirou Ndiaye (Lorient).
77' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
75' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
74' Romain Faivre (Lorient) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Anthony Lopes. What a save!
72' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' The substitution is prepared. Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ernest Nuamah.
70' Souleymane Isaak Toure (Lorient) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.
67' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Now Lyon have a corner.
67' Lyon are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
65' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
62' The ball goes out for a corner. Lyon can continue in their attacking effort.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mahamadou Diawara walks off the pitch to be replaced by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon).
60' Here is a change. Skelly Alvero is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Johann Lepenant (Lyon).
59' Substitution. Jeffinho makes his way off the pitch and Mama Balde (Lyon) comes on as his replacement.
57' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
55' 3 - 2 Goal! Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) takes a short pass from Darlin Yongwa in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the left post. 3:2.
53' Skelly Alvero (Lyon) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Jeffinho (Lyon) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
50' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Jeffinho (Lyon), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
50' Lorient can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' A lofted cross from Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Lorient force a corner. They send men into the box.
48' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
46' Half-time substitution. Julien Ponceau will not participate anymore and Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) is coming on.
46' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Formose Mendy (Lorient) replaces Julien Laporte.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
41' 3 - 1 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yvon Mvogo into the bottom right corner.
41' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

41' Souleymane Isaak Toure (Lorient) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Lyon after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
38' Lyon seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
35' Neat link-up play between Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) and Jeffinho, but Yvon Mvogo reads the game well and the move breaks down.
34' Chance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
33' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Maxence Caqueret (Lyon), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
33' Souleymane Isaak Toure (Lorient) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Clement Turpin stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
29' Skelly Alvero (Lyon) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
26' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
25' Clement Turpin blows his whistle as Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
22' 2 - 1 Goal Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon)! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) was put through by Jeffinho and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
21' 1 - 1 Goal! Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
21' The free kick into the penalty area from Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is cleared.
20' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
19' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' 0 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the top right corner.
15' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Anthony Lopes (Lyon) is able to continue to play.
13' Anthony Lopes (Lyon) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' A quickly taken corner by Lorient.

12' Romain Faivre (Lorient) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Lorient have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
9' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yvon Mvogo, who smothers the ball.
8' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) brought his opponent down.
5' Lorient are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lorient will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will supervise the game today.
